The series is trend-dominated with moderate seasonal strength and a moderate ranking stability hint suggesting a selective approach; a deterministic weighted averaging (DBA) may capture the trend while being robust to outliers.
The series has high trend strength and moderate ranking stability, but the top models are correlated. A softmax weighting may reduce dominance of the top model while still leveraging good ones.
Testing a trimmed_mean strategy to reduce influence of extreme outlier models while still using many models; trend dominated series may benefit from trimming the top 20% worst errors.
Test a simple mean of all 14 models to see if a fully inclusive average beats the selective median under strong trend dominance.
The series shows moderate ranking stability and strong trend; a selective per‑horizon weighting may capture horizon‑specific strengths.
Try a weighted combination using the error_trend handle (w4) to see if trend‑aware weighting improves over median; this is a new kind of strategy.
test a selective weighted combination on the top-7 pool using inverse_error to see if a tighter subset improves over median.
test a per‑horizon weighted combination on the selective pool4 using softmax‑negative‑error weights to see if horizon‑specific weighting improves over the flat median.

decision.justification: Selected 'median on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.0648. Series context: trend strength 0.9331 and seasonal strength 0.4008; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.546); 2 of 14 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 935740399539.46.
